plannedSources.conditions: The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

plannedSources.conditions: The Sandstone Wall , Ebonsandstone Wall , Crimsandstone Wall , and Pearlsandstone Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Sandstone Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Sandstone Walls may further spread conversion to other walls; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Sandstone Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

plannedSources.conditions: Wood is a type of block that is generally obtained by cutting down trees using an axe or a chainsaw . Regular Wood can be harvested from Forest trees , vanity trees , Living Trees , and Underground Cabins in underground or cavern layers, as well as by using the Faecorn . Forest trees can be cultivated by placing Acorns on top of regular grass or Mowed grass above surface , and vanity trees can be cultivated by placing Sakura Sapling or Yellow Willow Sapling on top of any grass (but yields Ebonwood or Shadewood instead if placed on Corrupt or Crimson grass variants).

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.conditions: Dungeon Bricks are a type of brick from which the Dungeon is constructed. On world generation, one of three colors of Dungeon Brick is chosen to create the entirety of the Dungeon. Dungeon Brick is one of very few block types that is impervious to explosions . 100% Pickaxe power (a Molten Pickaxe or better) is required to mine Dungeon Bricks in the Underground -level Dungeon, although any pickaxe can mine Dungeon Bricks at or above the Surface layer, and any Dungeon Bricks placed within the center third of the world. They can also be obtained from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates .

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.notes: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space . [ 1 ] The plant in a Planter Box cannot be cut in the regular manner, e.g. via nearby swinging tools. Instead, it needs to be removed with a pickaxe or drill , or the Staff of Regrowth or Axe of Regrowth .

blockedSources.conditions: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson , and less frequently underground . blockedSources.notes: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. blockedSources.conditions: Demon Altars and Crimson Altars are naturally-occurring crafting stations found mainly in and around chasms in The Corruption or Crimson , and less frequently underground . They are used to craft pre-Hardmode boss -summoning items and the Night's Edge as well as the Void Bag and Vault . Placed altars emit some light, making them easy to spot. They cannot be freed, picked up, or crafted. A Demon or Crimson Altar item will drop from the Eye of Cthulhu if no altars are present in the world.

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.conditions: Dungeon Bricks are a type of brick from which the Dungeon is constructed. On world generation, one of three colors of Dungeon Brick is chosen to create the entirety of the Dungeon. Dungeon Brick is one of very few block types that is impervious to explosions . 100% Pickaxe power (a Molten Pickaxe or better) is required to mine Dungeon Bricks in the Underground -level Dungeon, although any pickaxe can mine Dungeon Bricks at or above the Surface layer, and any Dungeon Bricks placed within the center third of the world. They can also be obtained from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates .

blockedSources.conditions: There are 5 types of regular moss: Green Moss, Brown Moss, Red Moss, Blue Moss, and Purple Moss. One of each regular moss can be found throughout each third of a given map (three variants per world). They can be found either randomly on cave surfaces or in moss chambers with a matching Mossy Wall.

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.notes: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Once placed, a Firework Rocket can be activated via wire or by pressing the ⚷ Open / Activate button on it directly, which causes it to launch upwards and explode into a colorful effect. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 SC each.

blockedSources.notes: Wrenches are tools for placing Wires , which are used to connect mechanisms together, such as a trap with a Pressure Plate . All wrenches are purchased from the Mechanic for 2 GC each.

blockedSources.conditions: The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

blockedSources.conditions: The Hardened Sand Wall , Hardened Ebonsand Wall , Hardened Crimsand Wall , and Hardened Pearlsand Wall are types of background walls which can be found naturally generated in the Underground Desert , considered unsafe . Underground Deserts generate by default the normal Hardened Sand Wall which may be converted into the respective variant if exposed to the Corruption , Crimson , or Hallow . Converted Hardened Sand Walls may further spread conversion; see Biome spread for more information. Unsafe Hardened Sand Walls do not drop as items when destroyed, and can only be obtained via crafting. They are considered safe walls when placed by the player.

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: Decorative statues have no function and only serve as decoration. They are generally found placed underground . The three Lihzahrd statues are only found in the Jungle Temple , and are the only statues that do not appear to be made of stone. The Armor Statue can also be crafted with 50 at a Work Bench .

landingRow.conditions: Decorative statues have no function and only serve as decoration. They are generally found placed underground . blockedSources.notes: Red, Brown, Gray, Orange, and Lihzahrd Pressure Plates are randomly generated on the map during world creation as the trigger for traps . They only take up a very small space on top of blocks , so they may be difficult to spot. The color of naturally spawned pressure plates is dependent on the color of the block they are generated on top of. Except for Lihzahrd Pressure Plates, they can also be purchased from the Mechanic .

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.notes: In addition, the Paint Sprayer accessory and its upgrades allow automatically applying paint to placed blocks, walls, and objects. It can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant .

blockedSources.notes: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space . [ 1 ] The plant in a Planter Box cannot be cut in the regular manner, e.g. via nearby swinging tools. Instead, it needs to be removed with a pickaxe or drill , or the Staff of Regrowth or Axe of Regrowth .

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: Decorative statues have no function and only serve as decoration. They are generally found placed underground . The three Lihzahrd statues are only found in the Jungle Temple , and are the only statues that do not appear to be made of stone. The Armor Statue can also be crafted with 50 at a Work Bench .

blockedSources.notes: Christmas Tree decorations are Hardmode furniture items used to decorate Christmas Trees . There are four categories: toppers, bulbs, lights, and garlands. Each tree can only include one of each type. Most decorations can be purchased from Santa Claus for 5 SC each, except for the Old-gen console -exclusive Star Topper 4, which can be found in Presents . [ 1 ]

blockedSources.notes: The Music Box is a Hardmode accessory and furniture item that can be purchased from the Wizard for 10 GC . When the Music Box is equipped in an accessory slot, it will record the currently playing in-game music after a randomized delay. This includes tracks being played by other Music Boxes. Once recorded, it will change into one of the Music Boxes listed below. A record sound alerts the player about a completed recording. Most Music Box variants can only be obtained by recording in-game music with the exception of Music Box (Journey's End) , which can be bought directly from the Princess for 10 GC after defeating the Moon Lord .

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: Dungeon Bricks are a type of brick from which the Dungeon is constructed. On world generation, one of three colors of Dungeon Brick is chosen to create the entirety of the Dungeon. Dungeon Brick is one of very few block types that is impervious to explosions . 100% Pickaxe power (a Molten Pickaxe or better) is required to mine Dungeon Bricks in the Underground -level Dungeon, although any pickaxe can mine Dungeon Bricks at or above the Surface layer, and any Dungeon Bricks placed within the center third of the world. They can also be obtained from Dungeon Crates or Stockade Crates .

blockedSources.conditions: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes . They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill . Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.notes: In addition, the Paint Sprayer accessory and its upgrades allow automatically applying paint to placed blocks, walls, and objects. It can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant .

blockedSources.notes: Red, Brown, Gray, Orange, and Lihzahrd Pressure Plates are randomly generated on the map during world creation as the trigger for traps . They only take up a very small space on top of blocks , so they may be difficult to spot. The color of naturally spawned pressure plates is dependent on the color of the block they are generated on top of. Except for Lihzahrd Pressure Plates, they can also be purchased from the Mechanic .

blockedSources.conditions: Ice Blocks are a common block type found alongside Snow Blocks in the Snow and Ice biomes . They can be mined with a pickaxe or drill . Ice Blocks have low friction, causing a player walking over them to slide when stopping or changing directions. This effect can be mitigated by equipping Ice Skates or other accessories crafted from them.

blockedSources.conditions: There are 5 types of regular moss: Green Moss, Brown Moss, Red Moss, Blue Moss, and Purple Moss. One of each regular moss can be found throughout each third of a given map (three variants per world). They can be found either randomly on cave surfaces or in moss chambers with a matching Mossy Wall.

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.notes: In addition, the Paint Sprayer accessory and its upgrades allow automatically applying paint to placed blocks, walls, and objects. It can be purchased from the Traveling Merchant .

blockedSources.notes: Wallpapers are a group of walls purchased from the Painter . Despite the name, they work just like any other type of wall and do not have to be applied onto other walls. As such, they can be placed and used to prevent enemies from spawning, and can be used to fulfill the requirements of a house .

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.notes: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw button). landingRow.notes: Torches are furniture items that function as light sources when placed , held, or dropped (via the Throw button). Regular Torches can be found randomly in Chests and Pots , as a bonus drop from slimes , Torch Zombies , or purchased from the Merchant or Skeleton Merchant for 50 CC each.

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: There are 5 types of regular moss: Green Moss, Brown Moss, Red Moss, Blue Moss, and Purple Moss. One of each regular moss can be found throughout each third of a given map (three variants per world). They can be found either randomly on cave surfaces or in moss chambers with a matching Mossy Wall.

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.notes: Planter Boxes are flat-surface items of furniture purchased from the Dryad for 1 SC each in which herb or flower seeds can be planted. If left empty, wild grass plants will randomly grow out of them, provided the box is placed on the surface or in Space . [ 1 ] The plant in a Planter Box cannot be cut in the regular manner, e.g. via nearby swinging tools. Instead, it needs to be removed with a pickaxe or drill , or the Staff of Regrowth or Axe of Regrowth .

blockedSources.notes: Red, Brown, Gray, Orange, and Lihzahrd Pressure Plates are randomly generated on the map during world creation as the trigger for traps . They only take up a very small space on top of blocks , so they may be difficult to spot. The color of naturally spawned pressure plates is dependent on the color of the block they are generated on top of. Except for Lihzahrd Pressure Plates, they can also be purchased from the Mechanic .

blockedSources.notes: Paint is used to modify the color of objects. Nearly anything can be painted, including blocks , background walls , and furniture , along with non-collectable environment objects like trees , tall grass, flowers, and other ambient growth. Basic paint is purchased from the Painter NPC . Two of the same color can be combined at a Dye Vat to create "deep" color versions, which apply their color more vividly and are required in order to paint certain objects.

blockedSources.conditions: Statues are furniture items. While some are purely decorative, others have a functional effect when activated via Wire —depending on the statue, it may spawn enemies , drop items , or teleport an NPC to the statue's location. Most statues can be found already placed in any area underground (most frequently in the Dungeon , Underground Cabins , and Cavern level), though Angel Statues also appear in Chests . Like all furniture, a pickaxe , a drill , or explosives are used to collect them.

blockedSources.conditions: Fences are a type of safe wall that are visually thin with most of them having transparency to allow view of the background. The only fences that have no transparency to them are Palm Fence , Rich Mahogany Fence , and Shadewood Fence . Unlike most other safe walls , they allow for wild plants and trees , except for palm trees and its variants, to grow. The safe grass wall , flower wall , and jungle wall are functionally identical to fences. All Fences are obtained by Crafting , although the Wrought Iron Fence can also be found on certain designs of the Dungeon and are obtainable there as well.

blockedSources.conditions: There are 5 types of regular moss: Green Moss, Brown Moss, Red Moss, Blue Moss, and Purple Moss. One of each regular moss can be found throughout each third of a given map (three variants per world). They can be found either randomly on cave surfaces or in moss chambers with a matching Mossy Wall.

blockedSources.conditions: Glowing mosses are special variants of moss that glow in vibrant colors. These include the Lava Moss, Krypton Moss, Xenon Moss, Argon Moss, Neon Moss, and Helium Moss. Lava Moss can be found in patches around the lava layer of the Caverns . Krypton, Xenon, Argon, and Neon Moss grow in glowing moss biomes and in much larger areas than other mosses, and only one type among these can be found in each world. Up to two ( small world ) / three ( medium world ) / four ( large world ) glowing moss biomes will be generated in the Cavern layer, mostly above the lava layers, but not near the horizontal center of the world. Helium Moss does not spawn naturally and can instead be obtained by throwing any other glowing moss into Shimmer .

blockedSources.notes: Red, Brown, Gray, Orange, and Lihzahrd Pressure Plates are randomly generated on the map during world creation as the trigger for traps . They only take up a very small space on top of blocks , so they may be difficult to spot. The color of naturally spawned pressure plates is dependent on the color of the block they are generated on top of. Except for Lihzahrd Pressure Plates, they can also be purchased from the Mechanic .

blockedSources.notes: Firework Rockets are consumable Hardmode mechanisms that produce colorful effects. Each rocket can only be used once. Firework Rockets are purchased from the Party Girl during Hardmode for 15 SC each.
